messages:
lucy_dev: hello all, jumping in day 1 — trying to run a live demo tomorrow. My local streaming client gets 429s. Console only shows one Org API Key; is there a way to create a short-lived/dev token for demos instead of using hosted key?

rahul: welcome! create an ephemeral token in Console -> API Keys -> Create Ephemeral Token. It's intended for demos and expires in a few hours. Don't use hosted long-lived keys on laptops.

lucy_dev: i couldn't find 'Create Ephemeral Token' — Console shows only 'Generate key' button. Could it be a permissions thing?

ops_alex: permissions likely — ephemeral token creation requires the "dev.tools" role. If you don't have it, file a support email to dev-tools@redwood with subject "ephemeral token access". Meanwhile eng-infra can issue a one-off token if you include the 429 payload and demo window.

lucy_dev: copying. attaching the 429 i saw: {"error":"rate_limit_exceeded","rate_bucket":"sb_stream_mini","retry_after":6} — i'm using the WebSocket sample from the python quickstart.

eng-infra: got it — sb_stream_mini is a low sandbox bucket. We can grant a 2-hour dev bump for demos. Please include demo window and estimated requests/min in the quota form: https://intranet.redwood/company-forms/compute-quota.

devex_bot: tip: if you must iterate live before the bump, record a small stream and replay it via a local proxy (simple HTTP replay or ngrok) to avoid burning quota. Also set small max_tokens and lower concurrency while iterating.

lucy_dev: two quick follow-ups: 1) any recommended env var patterns to avoid committing keys? 2) my corporate laptop uses a proxy — will ephemeral tokens work through proxies?

rahul: 1) use REDWOOD_API_KEY in your env, add .env to .gitignore, and include a .env.sample in the repo. 2) ephemeral tokens are bearer tokens and work over proxies; ensure the proxy allows websocket upgrades to api.redwood.company or fallback to SSE over HTTPS. Note SSE and WS can be rate-limited differently.

ops_alex: also implement exponential backoff and respect the Retry-After header. If you see repeated 429s with rate_bucket like sb_stream_mini include that JSON in the quota request. For IP whitelist or proxy exceptions open the secure-networking form: https://intranet.redwood/company-forms/network-whitelist.

lucy_dev: perfect — i'll file the quota form for tomorrow 09:00-11:00, ask dev-tools for ephemeral token permissions, and use replay for iteration now. thanks everyone :raised_hands:
